name: Tide Pool
description: A channel puzzle: lay channels across the sand so the tide fills every rock pool.

name: Tide Digger
description: Dig channels in the sand with your finger and steer the real-feeling tide into rock pools.

name: Merit Order
description: A power-plant tycoon in an NEM-style electricity market: build plants, bid into the merit order and keep the lights on.

name: Storm the Shore
description: Lead your landing squad up the beach: pick the right gates, grow your crowd and take the bunker.
